description: The app's own pages (served by riven on riven://localhost, a scheme Tauri counts as local) may move their window (drag regions, the title bar double-click), call riven's Rust commands (the generated set rust-main) and listen for the events Rust sends them. Scoped by webview label (app windows are w<n>, dockview popouts pop-<id>, the pet pet) so the browser panel's pages (bv-<n>), which share their window, get nothing.
